mix.rationale: No bank to review yet — pure acquisition.
First spaced reps kick in on Week 1's shakiest problems.
Review load grows as Week 1-2 patterns start decaying.
Backtracking is volume-heavy; review stays modest to protect new-pattern time.
DP requires the most new-material time of any week; review capped at 30% deliberately.
Still all-pattern, no company-repo time — breadth finishes before any tagged drilling starts.
New-pattern time goes to heap/trie/intervals/bit-manip/design, not companies. Company-repo browsing is light exposure only.
Review dominates because retention matters more than coverage now. Company-repo time stays a minority — pivot it upward only once a real interview is on the calendar.

leitner.meaning: Just solved / struggled / needed the write-up
Solved with a hint, or slow
Solved cleanly but not yet fast

rule: Every problem starts in Box 1. Bump it up one box each time you re-solve it cleanly and cold; drop it back to Box 1 if you fumble it on review — the point is catching decay before an interview does.
